versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00180 If for a dataElement to be sent a SenderComSpec with handleOutOfRange = ig- nore is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the sending component. If the value is out of bounds, the sending of the dataElement shall not be propagated. This means for a non-queued communication that the last valid value will be propagated and for a queued communication that no value will be enqueued. In case of a composite datatype the sending of the whole dataElement shall not be propagated, if any of the composite elements is out of bounds.
